PR Summary by Qodo

Add pinned agent-room protocols, subagent briefs, and owner manuals 📝 Documentation ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Define architect and lead protocols for planning, reviews, handovers, decisions, and recovery.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD Skill["Thin skill"] --> Architect["Architect protocol"] --> Client["room.py"] --> State["Project state"] Skill --> Lead["Lead protocol"] --> Briefs["Subagent briefs"] Lead --> Client Manuals["Owner manuals"] --> Architect Manuals --> Lead ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Keep all instructions in the skill
- ➕ One document to distribute and read. - ➖ Every procedural change requires replacing the saved skill. - ➖ Harder to pin different projects to different protocol versions.
2. Generate manuals from the protocols
- ➕ Could reduce drift between owner instructions and agent procedures. - ➖ Requires a documentation generator and source format not otherwise needed. - ➖ May make short, owner-focused troubleshooting guidance harder to maintain.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the thin, version-pinned skill and separate role protocols: they support project-specific pins without repeatedly replacing the skill. The manually written owner pages are reasonable, but reviewers should check cross-document consistency; the new tests validate links, command syntax, and page structure rather than procedural correctness.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
